title: Membership application
heading: Apply, in confidence.
intro: Tell us a little about you and the team will be in touch privately to arrange your consultation and diagnostics. Nothing is shared without your written consent.
note: Held in strict medical confidence. We will never contact you from an identifiable number or address without your say-so.

success.heading: Thank you — that is with us.
success.text: A member of Dr Wakil's team will contact you within one working day, discreetly, on whichever channel you chose.

error.heading: That did not send.
error.text: Please try again, or call the clinic directly and we will take your details by phone.

fields.name: goals
fields.label: What would you like to address?
fields.help: Optional. As much or as little as you wish to say at this stage.

fields.name: consent
fields.label: I consent to being contacted about my enquiry. All communication is strictly confidential.
